powerAudit: Initial preparation observed battery power. All formal measurements, including the first, started and ended on AC power. The extra OpenGL run checks order and repeat variability.
limitations: One process per backend/scenario with three consecutive 30-second samples; these are not three independent runs.
Measurements report application acceptance and fresh pictures, not the 60 Hz monitor's physical scanout.
Windows requested visible; lock, occlusion and visual correctness were not independently measured.
Current Iris Xe laptop and driver only; extrapolation to other GPUs requires their own measurements.
Combat simulation speed and casualties differ; use stable idle cases for the controlled backend comparison.
Vulkan shutdown retained allocation warnings are present; normal process exits do not prove leak-free cleanup.

instrumentationFix.description: Count CanvasFrameMetrics after visible OpenGL swap returns; same frozen updated runtime used for both backends.
